items.title: Newmont Reports Higher Profit Despite Lower Gold Prices
items.summary: Newmont  reported a higher second-quarter profit and growing revenue, but said its average gold prices fell compared to the first quarter.  The gold-mining company on Thursday reported a profit of $2.2 billion, or $2.06 a share.  Newmont’s average realized gold price rose to $4,414 an ounce from $3,320 a year earlier, but it was still lower than the company’s first-quarter average selling price of $4,900 as gold rallied in the beginning of the year.
